description:
The 'legacy-logging-system' project uses a deprecated static logger that needs to be migrated to a new Fluent API style. 

Your goal is to refactor `LogService.java` to replace all ~50 occurrences of:
`LegacyLogger.log(message, level, timestamp)`

with the new pattern:
`FluentLogger.at(level).withTime(timestamp).log(message)`

Note that the arguments are reordered: 
- `level` moves to the start (`.at()`)
- `timestamp` moves to the middle (`.withTime()`)
- `message` moves to the end (`.log()`)

Manual replacement is error-prone and slow. You should use IntelliJ's **Structural Search and Replace (SSR)** (Edit > Find > Replace Structurally...) to perform this migration safely and efficiently. The project must compile successfully after refactoring.
